mechanism: Prednisolone may increase methimazole metabolism via CYP3A4 induction while immunosuppressive effects can mask agranulocytosis risk; both drugs increase infection susceptibility and prednisolone impairs immune response to methimazole-related complications.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly, assess for signs of infection and agranulocytosis, consider dose adjustments of methimazole if prednisolone dosing changes significantly, and ensure appropriate infection prophylaxis.
